answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 28592 Country: India Title: When i was in school i used to offer salat without knowing the three farz(mandatory) things of bathing.So many times i offered salat in 'napak' condition.What should i suppose to do for all these salat now?any kaffara u know? Question: As salamualaikum, when i was in school i used to offer salat without knowing the three farz(mandatory) things of bathing.So many times i offered salat in 'napak' condition.What should i suppose to do for all these salat now?any kaffara u know? Answer ID: 28592 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 49/36/L=1432) After ghusl, if you offered salah making wudhu then your all salah were valid. Now you do not need to re-offer them. Because when you rinse your mouth or pass water into your nose at the time of wudhu it was enough and the fardh of ghusl was fulfilled. However, you should take care in future and complete the fardh of ghusl at the time bathing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
